outcome: sexual function (Female Sexual Function Index - FSFI)
cohort: The study included 211 women 2-5 years after a vaginal birth, categorized by episiotomy status or degree of perineal tear, recruited from gynaecological clinics in the Czech Republic.
finding: Women with second-degree perineal tears showed lower scores in arousal, orgasm, and total FSFI compared to those with first-degree tears and episiotomy in the overall sample, though this difference was not observed among primiparous women.
mod_finding: Women with second-degree perineal tears had lower sexual function scores in arousal, orgasm, and total FSFI compared to those with first-degree tears and women who received an episiotomy, though this finding did not hold true for primiparous women.
